Hospital Profile
The internship was completed at Chirag Hospital, a multi-specialty hospital providing quality
healthcare services. The hospital has departments such as General Medicine, Surgery,
Pediatrics, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Emergency, ICU, Operation Theatre, Laboratory,
Pharmacy, and Radiology. The hospital is equipped with modern medical facilities and
experienced healthcare professionals.

Departments Visited
During my hospital internship, I visited different departments to learn how each department
works and how nurses care for patients. The details are given below:
1. Outpatient Department (OPD)
In the OPD, I observed patient registration, consultation, and basic health check-ups. I
learned how nurses assist doctors, check vital signs, and guide patients.
2. Emergency Department (Casualty)
The emergency department provides immediate treatment to seriously ill or injured patients.
I observed first aid, emergency care, and how nurses respond quickly in critical situations.
3. General Medicine Ward

.
I observed first aid, emergency care, and how nurses respond quickly in critical situations.
3. General Medicine Ward
In this ward, I observed the care of patients with illnesses such as fever, diabetes,
hypertension, and infections. I learned about medication administration, monitoring vital
signs, and maintaining patient records.
4. General Surgery Ward
I learned about the care of patients before and after surgery. Nurses monitored patients,
changed dressings, administered medicines, and observed recovery.
5. Orthopedic Ward
This ward treats patients with bone and joint problems. I observed fracture management,
plaster care, patient positioning, and mobility assistance.
6. Pediatrics Department
In this department, I learned how nurses care for infants and children. I observed

assistance.
6. Pediatrics Department
In this department, I learned how nurses care for infants and children. I observed
immunization, growth monitoring, medication administration, and communication with
parents.
7. Obstetrics and Gynecology Department
I observed the care of pregnant women, mothers after delivery, and women with
gynecological conditions. I also learned about antenatal and postnatal care.

8. Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
The ICU provides care for critically ill patients. I observed patient monitoring, oxygen
therapy, ventilator care, and infection control practices.
9. Operation Theatre (OT)
In the operation theatre, I learned about maintaining a sterile environment, preparing surgical
instruments, assisting during surgeries, and post-operative care.
10. Laboratory
I observed the collection and testing of blood, urine, and other samples. I learned the
importance of laboratory reports in diagnosis and treatment.
11. Radiology Department
This department performs X-rays, CT scans, and ultrasound examinations. I observed

treatment.
11. Radiology Department
This department performs X-rays, CT scans, and ultrasound examinations. I observed
patient preparation and safety during imaging procedures.
12. Pharmacy
I learned about medicine storage, dispensing medicines according to prescriptions, and
maintaining drug records.
13. Blood Bank
I observed blood collection, blood grouping, storage, and the safe process of blood
transfusion.
14. Central Sterile Supply Department (CSSD)
I learned how surgical instruments and medical equipment are cleaned, sterilized, packed,
and supplied to different hospital departments.

Challenges Faced During Hospital
Nursing Internship
During my hospital internship, I faced several challenges that helped me learn and grow as a
nursing student. These experiences improved my confidence, skills, and ability to work in a
healthcare setting.
1. Communicating with Patients
At the beginning of my internship, I felt nervous while talking to patients and their family
members. With regular practice and guidance from the nursing staff, I became more
confident in communicating politely and effectively.
2. Managing Time
It was difficult to complete many nursing duties within a limited time, especially during busy

tively.
2. Managing Time
It was difficult to complete many nursing duties within a limited time, especially during busy
shifts. I learned to plan my work, set priorities, and complete tasks efficiently.
3. Handling Emergency Situations
The emergency department was a new experience for me. Initially, I found it challenging to
stay calm during emergency cases, but by observing experienced nurses, I learned how to
respond quickly and work as part of a team.
4. Maintaining Infection Control
Following all infection control measures, such as proper hand hygiene, wearing PPE, and
maintaining sterility, required constant attention. I learned that these practices are essential
for patient and staff safety.

5. Performing Clinical Procedures
As a student, I had limited practical experience. Some procedures, such as wound dressing,
sample collection, and IV care, were challenging at first. Under the supervision of staff
nurses, I gradually gained confidence and improved my skills.
6. Emotional Challenges
Seeing patients in pain or serious condition was emotionally difficult. I learned to remain
calm, show compassion, and provide emotional support while maintaining professionalism.
7. Learning Hospital Documentation
Understanding and maintaining patient records correctly was challenging in the beginning.
With guidance from the nursing staff, I learned the importance of accurate and timely
documentation.

8. Adapting to the Hospital Environment
Adjusting to hospital rules, shift duties, teamwork, and a busy working environment took
time. As the internship progressed, I became more comfortable and adapted to the routine.
